summary: Enerflex Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, announcing its first quarter 2026 financial and operational results. The filing is a routine earnings report under SEC requirements for foreign private issuers. It discloses revenue of $584 million, adjusted EBITDA of $137 million, and a record return on capital employed of 17.3%. There are no special situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. The filing includes financial statements, management discussion, and voting results, but no transaction or event that would classify it as a special situation. This is a standard periodic report with no actionable deal terms.
